summary: PetVivo Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a Termination and Settlement Agreement with VetStem, Inc., terminating their February 13, 2025 Exclusive License and Supply Agreement effective July 24, 2026. All exclusive rights reverted to VetStem; PetVivo transferred remaining PrecisePRP inventory and mutually released claims. PetVivo's sole financial obligation is $75,000 aggregate cash payments: $50,000 within 14 days and $25,000 within 30 business days. Inventory shortfall could trigger additional payment, amount omitted as immaterial and competitively sensitive. All other financial obligations, including royalties and milestones, are extinguished. Watch for inventory reconciliation and any residual IP disputes.
